faq_heading: Tsawwassen Central condos and townhomes: your questions answered

faq.q: What did condos and townhomes in Tsawwassen Central sell for?
faq.a: 8 condos sold in Tsawwassen Central between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $557,500.

faq.q: How long do condos and townhomes take to sell in Tsawwassen Central?
faq.a: The median was 68 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.7% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most condos and townhomes in Tsawwassen Central sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 8 condos that sold in Tsawwassen Central went for between $503,375 and $593,750, around a median of $557,500.

faq.q: Do condos and townhomes in Tsawwassen Central sell above asking price?
faq.a: 0% of the 8 condos sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 96.7% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for condos and townhomes in Tsawwassen Central?
faq.a: Of the 8 sales, 8 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $578.

faq.q: How old are the condos and townhomes that sold in Tsawwassen Central?
faq.a: The median year built was 1992 for the 8 condos sold in Tsawwassen Central.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do condos and townhomes in Tsawwassen Central usually have?
faq.a: The median condo that sold in Tsawwassen Central had 2 bedrooms, from the 8 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

What Tsawwassen Central condos and townhomes sold for, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026

8 condos sold in Tsawwassen Central with a median price of $557,500 (the middle half sold between $503,375 and $593,750), taking a median of 68 days to sell at 96.7% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $508 per square foot, a median year built of 1992 and a median strata fee of $578 a month.

blocks.text: How Tsawwassen Central compares with the rest of Tsawwassen

The median condo in Tsawwassen Central sold for $557,500, 5% below the Tsawwassen median of $585,000 across 97 sales. Tsawwassen Central condos took a median 68 days to sell, against 44 days for Tsawwassen as a whole.
